subject.title: fix(browser): navigate works with CDP hostname allowlist

question: Should this exact-host CDP control-plane allowlist relaxation be accepted after live proof, or should maintainers require a separate control-policy design first?
rationale: The code and tests support the narrow helper fix, but the diff changes a browser SSRF boundary, so final acceptance needs maintainer security-boundary intent rather than automation alone.

options.title: Accept after live proof
options.body: Land this scoped helper fix once redacted live browser proof shows the restrictive allowlist flow works and disallowed navigation remains blocked.

options.title: Require separate control policy
options.body: Pause this PR and ask for a design that passes an explicitly separate CDP control policy instead of extending the shared helper behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept after live proof
recommendation.body: Land this scoped helper fix once redacted live browser proof shows the restrictive allowlist flow works and disallowed navigation remains blocked.
